title: Dazzling Dubai (4N/5D)
tagline: Ascend the iconic Burj Khalifa, surge across red desert dunes in a 4x4, and marvel at the Grand Mosque.

bestTime.notes: November through March provides delightfully pleasant sunny days (22°C to 28°C) perfect for outdoor desert safaris, beach strolls, and al fresco rooftop dining.

visaInfo: UAE Tourist Visa required for Indian passport holders. We provide complete end-to-end visa assistance (processed within 3-4 working days). Passports must be valid for at least 6 months from the date of travel.
overview: Immerse yourself in the world's most visionary metropolis on an unforgettable five-day luxury showcase of Dubai and Abu Dhabi. From the moment you land beneath the soaring palm terminals of Dubai International Airport, experience seamless VIP hospitality. Cruise through the Venetian-inspired Dubai Marina on a traditional glass-enclosed wooden Dhow, dining on an international buffet as neon-lit skyscrapers reflect upon the tranquil waters. Ascend at high speed to the 124th and 125th observation decks of the iconic Burj Khalifa, gazing out across the Arabian Gulf, before witnessing the world's largest synchronized water fountains dance to classical melodies. Journey deep into the sweeping crimson dunes of the Lahbab Desert aboard a rugged 4x4 Land Cruiser for heart-pounding dune bashing, camel rides, and an authentic Bedouin camp feast accompanied by Tanura and fire dancers. Expand your horizons with a full-day excursion to Abu Dhabi to witness the marble domes of the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and the historic BAPS Hindu Mandir.
highlights: Ascent to the 124th & 125th observation floors of the world's tallest tower, the Burj Khalifa
Thrilling 4x4 Land Cruiser dune bashing across the red sands of the Lahbab Desert
Bedouin desert camp evening with camel rides, henna painting, fire show, and BBQ dinner
2-hour evening Marina Dhow Cruise featuring international buffet dining and live music
Half-day Dubai city tour covering Dubai Frame, Burj Al Arab, and Palm Jumeirah monorail
Full-day guided excursion to Abu Dhabi covering the magnificent Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
Visit to the newly inaugurated master-crafted BAPS Hindu Mandir in Abu Dhabi
Sensory exploration of the historic Gold Souk and aromatic Spice Souk in Deira Old Dubai

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai & Marina Dhow Cruise Buffet Dinner
itinerary.description: Touch down at Dubai International Airport (DXB) where our private representative welcomes you in the arrival hall. Enjoy a swift transfer to your centrally located four-star hotel. Take time to relax and refresh after your flight. In the evening at 7:00 PM, transfer to Dubai Marina to board a beautifully illuminated traditional two-deck wooden Dhow. Glide gently through the canal framed by illuminated luxury yachts and towering neon spires. Savor a lavish five-star international buffet dinner with live acoustic melodies before returning to your hotel.
itinerary.transferInfo: Private AC transfer from DXB Airport to hotel (15 km, 20 mins); shared transfer for evening Dhow Cruise.

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour, Dubai Mall & Burj Khalifa 124th Floor
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a panoramic guided city tour. Capture iconic photos at the Dubai Frame, pass the palatial royal estates of Zabeel, and pause along Jumeirah Beach overlooking the sail-shaped Burj Al Arab. Drive across the Palm Jumeirah archipelago past the majestic Atlantis The Palm resort. By mid-afternoon, arrive at The Dubai Mall, the world's largest entertainment complex. Board the high-speed elevator to the 124th and 125th floors of the Burj Khalifa for breathtaking 360-degree panoramic views. Conclude with the spectacular evening Dubai Fountain water and light show.
activities: Burj Al Arab & Palm Jumeirah Photo Stops
itinerary.transferInfo: Air-conditioned touring coach for morning city tour and afternoon Downtown Dubai transfers.

itinerary.title: Deira Souk Markets & 4x4 Desert Safari with BBQ Dinner
itinerary.description: Spend a relaxed morning exploring Old Dubai's vibrant trading alleys. Ride an authentic wooden Abra boat across Dubai Creek (AED 1) to browse dazzling window displays in the Gold Souk and breathe in fragrant frankincense at the Spice Souk. At 3:00 PM, get picked up in a rugged 4x4 Land Cruiser heading for the deep Lahbab desert. Experience an adrenaline-charged 30-minute dune bashing adventure over rolling red sands. Stop on a high ridge for sunset photography before entering a traditional Bedouin camp for camel rides, henna art, Tanura dances, and a barbecue dinner under the stars.
activities: Old Dubai Gold & Spice Souk Walk
Bedouin Camp Fire Show & BBQ Dinner
itinerary.transferInfo: 4x4 Toyota Land Cruiser private/shared pickup from hotel to Lahbab Desert Camp and return.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Abu Dhabi: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque & BAPS Mandir
itinerary.description: After an early breakfast, travel 140 kilometers southwest along the Sheikh Zayed desert highway to Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates. First visit the architectural marvel of the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, admiring its 82 white marble domes, reflective pools, and the world's largest hand-knotted Persian carpet. Next, visit the newly consecrated BAPS Hindu Mandir, a magnificent pink sandstone and Italian Carrara marble temple carved with ancient spiritual motifs. Continue along the Abu Dhabi Corniche past the Emirates Palace and Ferrari World photo stop before returning to Dubai.
activities: Corniche Drive & Emirates Palace Photo Stop
Ferrari World Abu Dhabi Photo Stop
itinerary.transferInfo: Private or shared air-conditioned coach for full-day Abu Dhabi excursion (140 km each way, 1.5 hours per leg).

itinerary.title: Final Shopping, Souvenirs & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely morning buffet breakfast at the hotel. Spend your remaining hours picking up premium Arabian dates from Bateel, designer chocolates, perfumes, or electronics at the Mall of the Emirates or City Centre Deira. Return to the hotel to pack your luggage and complete checkout formalities. Your private chauffeur will pick you up at the lobby and transfer you seamlessly to Dubai International Airport (DXB) in time for your flight home, concluding an extraordinary Middle Eastern getaway.
itinerary.transferInfo: Private AC sedan transfer from hotel to Dubai International Airport (DXB) (15 km, 20 mins).

tips: Dress code for Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is strictly enforced: women must wear loose ankle-length trousers or skirts, long sleeves, and a headscarf (hijab); men must wear full-length trousers and shirts.
Dubai tap water is safe for brushing, but bottled mineral water is provided complimentary in hotel rooms and on tours.
The local currency is the UAE Dirham (AED), pegged to the US Dollar (1 USD = 3.67 AED, approx. ₹22.5 to ₹23 per AED); cards are accepted almost everywhere.
Metro trains and public transport are remarkably clean and efficient; purchase an RTA Silver Nol Card if you wish to explore independently on free evenings.

faqs.question: How long does it take to process a UAE tourist visa for Indian citizens?
faqs.answer: UAE tourist e-visas are typically processed within 3 to 4 working days. You simply need to provide clear color passport front and back scans, a passport-sized white background photograph, and confirmed flight details.

faqs.question: What is the dress code for visiting the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque in Abu Dhabi?
faqs.answer: Modesty is strictly observed. Women must wear loose clothing covering wrists and ankles, and cover their heads with a scarf. Men must wear long trousers and shirts with sleeves. Tight clothing, translucent fabrics, and shorts are strictly forbidden.

faqs.question: Is dune bashing safe for seniors and children?
faqs.answer: Dune bashing is thrilling and bumpy. Pregnant women, travellers with back or neck conditions, and infants under 3 years are advised against dune bashing. We can easily arrange for you to travel directly to the campsite in a gentle, non-bashing 4x4 vehicle.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade my Burj Khalifa ticket to the 148th floor (At the Top SKY)?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our package includes standard tickets to floors 124 and 125. You can easily upgrade to the VIP 148th floor SKY lounge with priority elevators and refreshments for an additional differential fee.

faqs.question: Is vegetarian, Jain, or Indian food easily available in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Dubai is exceptionally welcoming to Indian culinary preferences. Pure vegetarian, Jain, and South/North Indian restaurants are abundant in Bur Dubai, Karama, Deira, and in every major mall food court.

faqs.question: What is the Tourism Dirham fee?
faqs.answer: The Tourism Dirham is a nominal mandatory municipal hospitality tax instituted by the Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism. For 4-star hotels, it is AED 15 (approx. ₹340) per bedroom per night, payable directly to the front desk at checkout.

faqs.question: What is the best way to carry money in Dubai?
faqs.answer: We recommend carrying a zero-forex-markup card (such as Niyo or bookmyforex) or an international credit card for shopping, along with 200 to 400 AED in cash for small purchases, souk bargains, and tips.
